name: os-emulator-coding-platform
description: A cross-platform (web, iOS, Android) OS emulator coding platform with AI assistance

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w mobile"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w mobile
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.test: npm test -w frontend && npm test -w backend && npm test -w mobile
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w mobile
